translations.web: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
translations.bsb: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
translations.kjv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
translations.asv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, And to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
